=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:245 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_own_run_id` accepts any `details_url` that contains the repo path as a substring, with no host or prefix anchor, so a foreign URL embedding the repo path yields a run id treated as this repository's.
  WHY: The judge then posts `rerun-failed-jobs` and a dedupe marker for that id in the configured repo; reviewers disagreed on severity (NIT/hardening vs MAJOR), and the highest is kept. Impact is bounded to at most 3 same-repo reruns per head.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If every settled blocking run concluded cancelled or timed_out, request one rerun of that workflow run's failed jobs" once per head and run id.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, rb_judge_settled_check_diagnostics
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The rerun loop at scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1014-1018 caps reruns at 3, so the 4th and later blocking runs are skipped with `reason=rerun_capped`. (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reviewed this and judged it not a gap.)
- requirement: Provide `RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED` as an off switch for the new behavior.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, review-blocked judge step environment
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The scripts read the variable, but the workflow passes no repository variable or other configurable value to the judge step or the comment step. (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reviewed this and judged it not a gap.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:245 (`_own_run_id` in `_pr_checks_blocking_detail`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The repo match is a substring test, with no host or prefix anchor, so a foreign URL containing the repo path is read as a run in this repository.
  WHY: The judge may post `rerun-failed-jobs` and a marker for that id; the effect is limited to one rerun on a same-repo run, at most 3 per head, deduplicated per run id.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: anchor with `startswith("https://github.com/" + repo + "/actions/runs/")`, keeping the current behavior when `GITHUB_SERVER_URL` is not github.com. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  WHY: An attacker URL such as `https://attacker.example/path/to/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234` returns id 1234 as if it belonged to this repository, leading to reruns against the wrong target.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:245 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The same-repo check is an unanchored `contains` on the lowercased `details_url`; it matches `https://attacker.example/prefix/owner/repo/actions/runs/4711` and `https://github.com/evil/owner/repo/actions/runs/4711`. The run id flows into `PR_CHECKS_LAST_BLOCKING_RUN_IDS` and `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1035`.
  WHY: The judge spends its one rerun and dedupe marker on an unrelated run id. Impact is bounded (≤3 runs, once per head and run, marker-deduped, POST targets the real repository), so this is hardening, not a blocker.
